investigation_notes.Description: An unusually large bulk download of 1,120 files from a restricted SharePoint HR/Finance site was observed at 2026-01-31T23:04:12Z (≈ 2026-02-01 01:04:12 local time in Tallinn), which is outside normal business hours. The account belongs to a Senior Software Developer in Engineering and accessed sensitive payroll, executive reviews, and banking data, representing a ~112x increase over the user's 24-hour baseline of 10 downloads. No recent related events or similar alerts were found, making this a singular and anomalous exfiltration that presents a high risk and warrants escalation.
